messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — deploys to gpu-pool are intermittently failing with 403s for the deployer SA. Happened 3x in last hour, e.g. ci job #3829. Anyone else seeing this?

Alex Rivera: seeing same, only on us-east-1-prod cluster. kube events show 'Forbidden: User "system:serviceaccount:deployer:deployer-sa" cannot create resource "pods" in API group "" in the namespace "gpu-pool"'

Jin Park: could be a RoleBinding scoping issue. I queried RBAC and noticed a RoleBinding named `deployer-edit` exists in the `default` namespace, not `gpu-pool`. Suspect helm hook templating used `{{ .Release.Namespace }}` incorrectly when chart-operator runs.

Ops Anna: can you paste the audit log entry?

Alex Rivera: quick repro commands I ran:
```
kubectl auth can-i create pods --as=system:serviceaccount:deployer:deployer-sa -n gpu-pool
# => no
kubectl get rolebinding deployer-edit -n default -o yaml
```

sec-bot: audit log snippet -> 2025-11-02T12:02:18Z chart-operator@helm-hook created RoleBinding "deployer-edit" namespace="default"; subjects: [ServiceAccount: deployer:deployer-sa]; roleRef: Role/edit.

Maya Chen: ah — chart-operator runs in the controller namespace (default) and Helm hooks execute there. Our chart templates use `.Release.Namespace`, but the Helm release is driven from the operator namespace; the chart was deployed with `targetNamespace` in values, so the RoleBinding ended up in the controller ns.

Jin Park: proposed fix: change chart template to explicitly use `.Values.targetNamespace` for namespaced RoleBindings, and add a unit/e2e test that renders the chart with different `.Release.Namespace` vs `.Values.targetNamespace`. Also add a policy to disallow hooks creating RoleBindings without an explicit namespace reference.

Alex Rivera: mitigation taken: created a RoleBinding `deployer-edit` in `gpu-pool` binding deployer-sa to the edit role; CI jobs that hit the 403 are now passing. Long-term fix still needed in chart repo.

Ops Anna: patched live, rolling watch on related CI pipelines. Opening incident ticket to track PR + postmortem.

sec-bot: added temporary alert: flag RoleBinding creates where `binding.namespace != .release.namespace` when actor == chart-operator. Will monitor for further mis-scoped bindings.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone — I'll open the chart PR and assign to Jin for review. :thumbsup:
